{{infobox character | name = Haldor | image = Haldor Definitive.png | caption = | id = Haldor | aliases = | affiliation = | marital = | birthDate = | birthPlace = | deathDate = | deathPlace = | species = Dvergr | gender = Male | height = | weight = | eyes = Light blue }} '''Haldor''' is a [[Creatures#NPCs|character]] found in [[Black Forest]]. He is a [[Dvergr (race)|Dvergr]] trader wearing a brown cloak, a gold belt and cape. At his camp, Haldor sells several unique items that can be purchased if the buyer has a sufficient amount of [[Coins]] and world progression. ==Biography== Nothing is known about Haldor beyond his occupation as a trader within [[Valheim (world)|Valheim]]. At some point in time, he set up camp within the Black Forest and tamed a [[Lox]] named [[Halstein]] that can be seen feeding from a bowl in the same camp. Haldor is a Dvergr or "dwarf", according to his introduction on Iron Gate's bloghttps://archive.md/s5GAU#selection-713.0-713.40, and how he refers to himself by one of his many quotes. Haldor says multiple phrases including "I'm short for a dwarf", "Check this stuff out", "Take a look at my wares" and "Radjdadaj…" [[Hildir]], Haldor's sister, can be found in [[Meadows]]. ==Location== [[File:HaldorsCamp.png|thumb|right|300px]] Haldor has 10 possible spawn locations that are located in [[Black Forest]]s which are at least 1500 meters away from the center of the world. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place Haldor there. This can happen from 320 to 453 meters away (about twice of the default minimap range) when the related [[Zones]] are generated. When discovered, his bag icon will appear on the world map. He spawns with his own [[Points of Interest (POI)|point of interest]], a small camp consisting of a large wooden wagon pulled by [[Halstein]], a propped up canopy, barrels, tables and multiple display items including spears, swords, shields, helmets and food. The camp is surrounded by a shimmering, transparent dome that acts as a safety zone that [[Creatures]] cannot enter. The safe zone cannot be destroyed. The [[Bearskin Rug]] situated next to Haldor can be destroyed to drop a [[Bear Trophy]]. No other furniture can be destroyed inside the force field. ==Trading== ===Sells=== {| class="wikitable sortable" ! Name ! Starttrade * Take a look at my wares. * Check this stuff out! * I'm sure I've got what you need. * I've got a little bit of everything. * My wares aren't exactly bespoke, but they'll do the job.}} ==Tips== When players find Haldor, it can be a good idea to set up a [[Portal]] in the vicinity for future visits. ==Gallery== Artwork of Haldor during 2023 Yuletide Valheim.jpeg|Artwork of Haldor during 2023 Yuletide Valheim Haldor distance.jpg|Approximate maximum distance Haldor's bag icon will appear Haldor edge.jpg|In this seed, Haldor appears near the edge of the world ==Trivia== *"Haldor" is a name having roots in Old Norse origins. Its meaning is presumably "Thor's rock".[https://www.behindthename.com/name/haldor Meaning, origin and history of the name Haldor - Behind the Name] *The transparent dome which surrounded Haldor's camp apparently powered by four small runestones placed around it and that each of them carved with Odin's Illusory Rune, a Viking glyph devised to provide camouflage and deception. This is fitting as the barrier only allows Haldor's potential customers to both see his camp and pass through it while hostile beings such as Greydwarfs cannot enter. ==References== {{Creatures}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[de:Haldor]] [[fr:Haldor]] [[ru:Хальдор]] [[cs:Haldor]]
